# pcd_networking_qos_policy (Data Source)

Look up a Neutron QoS policy by name or ID.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "pcd_networking_qos_policy" "example" {
  name = "tf-example-qos"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `name` (String) Look up by name.
- `policy_id` (String) Look up by policy ID (takes precedence over name).
- `region` (String) The region. Defaults to the provider's region.
- `tenant_id` (String) Filter by (and report) the owning project.

### Read-Only

- `description` (String) The policy description.
- `id` (String) The QoS policy ID.
- `is_default` (Boolean) Whether this is the default policy for the project.
- `project_id` (String) The owning project ID.
- `shared` (Boolean) Whether the policy is shared across all projects.
- `tags` (Set of String) Tags applied to the policy.
